identity_sources.observation: Massachusetts Health Policy Commission's UHS chart identifies UHS of Westwood Pembroke, Inc. dba Pembroke Hospital as a wholly owned UHS-related psychiatric-hospital entity.

The federal OSHA Review Commission decision states that UHS-WP owns and operates Pembroke Hospital and operated Pembroke, Westwood Lodge and Lowell Treatment Center as one legal entity under one license.
The Westwood municipal document identifies the former Westwood Lodge at 45 Clapboardtree Street, matching the CMS roster address.

browser_observation: No stable current hospital-owned pricing domain was exposed in this discovery pass. Search results point to the Pembroke/Westwood UHS entity, while the roster address is the former Westwood Lodge campus; the current operating status and facility-specific CMS pointer remain unresolved.
interpretation: The operator/entity and roster campus are now supported, but the evidence does not establish whether CCN 224023 remains active at Westwood, was consolidated under Pembroke Hospital, or terminated when Westwood Lodge closed. No sibling file was assigned and no closure or compliance conclusion was inferred.
next_action: Obtain authoritative CMS enrollment/termination or Massachusetts licensing evidence for CCN 224023 and the 45 Clapboardtree Street campus, then locate the applicable current or historical facility-specific pricing pointer/MRF.
